description: The first SIMPLE iteration as the DCTS dataset recorded it for SCANO (refine c018c80 src/Precompute/stage_unconverged.py, stage 2b): the linear solvers exit at once (tolerance 10, maxIter 1, one corrector), so the iteration writes the boundary values the conditions give the initial field. SIMPLEC off: the dataset's solver (stock buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam + boundary write, dcdtuni 7b53f528) has no consistent form, and the fixedFluxPressure faces' p_rgh follows rAU (with consistent on it comes out 0.57x). writeFormat binary: decomposePar writes the rank meshes in it (fast to read); the boundary write re-writes every volField in ASCII.
